description: Temporary pnpm security overrides. Recheck package advisories during dependency upgrades and remove each override once its parent dependency resolves a patched version without the override.

overrides.hono: 4.13.16 — fix advisories affecting Hono transitive dependencies.
overrides.proxy-addr: 2.0.8 — fix IPv4-mapped IPv6 trusted-proxy subnet spoofing.
overrides.sharp: 0.35.5 — includes patched librsvg and libheif dependencies.
overrides.@modelcontextprotocol/sdk: 1.32.0 — fixes reported MCP SDK task isolation, request validation/body limits, and related transport advisories.
overrides.source-map-js: 1.2.2 — fixes indexed source-map offset denial of service.
overrides.fast-uri: 3.1.9 — fixes reported URI parsing and host-confusion issues on the 3.x line.
overrides.ip-address: 10.7.4 — fixes reported IP parsing, classification, SSRF/trust-boundary, and long-input denial-of-service issues.
overrides.body-parser: 2.4.0 — fixes compressed request body trailing-byte denial of service.
overrides.nanoid: 3.3.18 — fixes zero/negative-size generator loops and integer range issues on the 3.x line.
overrides.brace-expansion: 5.0.12 — includes reported expansion length, recursion, intermediate allocation, and CPU denial-of-service fixes.
overrides.js-yaml: 4.3.2 — patches merge-key CPU exhaustion and merge-source limit bypass issues on the 4.x line.
overrides.browserslist: 4.28.7 — fixes untrusted stats handling and unbounded cache growth.
overrides.baseline-browser-mapping: 2.11.0 — fixes process termination on invalid input.
overrides.minimatch: 11.0.1 — patched release for glob-parts amplification; major-version override requires compatibility checks.
overrides.zod: 4.6.6 — patched release for oversized collection validation; major-version override requires compatibility checks.
overrides.@hono/node-server: 2.1.6 — patched release for the reported Node adapter request-path and WebSocket issues.
overrides.postcss-selector-parser: 7.1.6 — fixes selector parsing complexity and recursion denial of service.
